name: bankstatemently
description: Convert your bank statements into structured, queryable financial data — transactions, accounts, and balances from any PDF statement, then analyze them across every statement you've uploaded.

interface.longDescription:
Bankstatemently converts PDF bank statements into structured transaction data.

Attach a bank statement PDF to get its accounts, balances, and transactions in the chat, or as a CSV, Excel, QBO, or Xero file. You can then list your converted statements, categorize transactions, and total or group spending by category, merchant, or month.

Requires a Bankstatemently account. Bankstatemently reads the PDF you provide and never connects to your bank.
capabilities: Export to CSV, Excel, QBO, or Xero
Group spending by category, merchant, or month
defaultPrompt: Convert this bank statement PDF into a spreadsheet
Show my top merchants across my converted statements
Export my statement to QuickBooks format
